title: Majinahanashi Strikes Asia Market Ltd in Ireland
content_md: Summary On October 17, 2026 , the ransomware group majinahanashi claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Asia Market Ltd ( asiamarket.ie ), a prominent retail company in Ireland. The group has threatened to release sensitive data online unless their demands are met.
